Q-01.answer: Meals on business travel are covered at EUR 55 per day. Hotels are capped at EUR 160 a night (EUR 220 in London, Paris and Zurich), and booking through the travel desk applies the rate for you. [D-01#1]

Q-02.answer: The primary caregiver gets 20 weeks of parental leave at full pay, and the secondary caregiver gets 6 weeks. You can split it into up to three blocks within 18 months. [D-03#1]

Q-03.answer: Yes, up to 5 unused days carry over, but you have to use them by 31 March. [D-04#1]

Q-04.answer: In December pay day is 20 December. In other months salaries are paid on the 25th, or the last working day before it. [D-18#1]

Q-05.answer: In London the hotel cap is EUR 220 per night (EUR 160 elsewhere, except Paris and Zurich, which are also EUR 220). [D-01#1]

Q-06.answer: You have a EUR 1,200 learning budget each year for courses, books and conferences; your manager approves it. [D-14#2]

Q-07.answer: Submit the expense with its receipt within 30 days. Anything older than 90 days is not reimbursed. [D-01#2]

Q-08.answer: Twice a year, in March and September, by a panel of two leads who did not manage you. [D-17#1]

Q-09.answer: Anything over EUR 300 needs your manager's approval first, and flights also need Finance. [D-01#3]

Q-10.answer: The wellbeing allowance is EUR 40 per month and covers the gym, sport or therapy. [D-14#1]

Q-11.answer: Yes, but only until 14:00 on Fridays (Monday to Thursday until 16:00). Nothing goes out between 20 December and 3 January. [D-08#2]

Q-12.answer: Acknowledge a Sev1 page within 5 minutes; if it needs production access, the incident commander can grant 4 hours of break-glass access. [D-07#1] [D-09#2]

Q-13.answer: Employees on the engineering on-call rota get production access through the access gateway, approved by their lead. It has to be renewed every 90 days, and contractors never get standing access. [D-09#1]

Q-14.answer: A 15% discount needs your sales manager's approval (you can go up to 10% yourself). Log the approval in the deal record before you send the order form. [D-10#1] [D-10#2]

Q-15.answer: Invoice monthly by the 5th working day, with your hours by project. Invoices are paid within 14 days. [D-16#1]

Q-16.answer: Yes, contractors get a company laptop too, replaced every three years. Report a lost or stolen one to IT within 24 hours. [D-12#1]

Q-20.answer: Contractors are not on the employee leave scheme, so parental leave works through your contract. Tell your project lead about planned absences two weeks ahead. [D-16#2]

Q-23.answer: Q3 revenue was EUR 4.2 million, 6% under plan. Runway is 22 months. [D-15#1]

Q-24.answer: Engineer L3 is EUR 64,000 to EUR 78,000. [D-05#1]

Q-28.answer: Above 20%, or for any multi-year price lock, the CFO has to approve. [D-10#1]

Q-29.answer: Account executive base salary is EUR 48,000 to EUR 60,000, with on-target earnings up to EUR 95,000. [D-05#2]

Q-30.answer: The meal allowance is EUR 45 per day on business travel. [D-02#1]
